title: Iterated Dynamic-Programming Initialization
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean choices, let $c,B,e,i\in\mathbb N$, and let $x$ be a bit string. Put $s=c\bigl(|\mathrm{bits}(|x|)|+1\bigr)$ and $V=B(|x|+1)^e$. After $i$ iterations of the dynamic-programming update, its encoding initialized from $N,c,B,e,x$ is the pairing of the context encoding for these parameters and the encoded vector whose entry at each index $a<V$ is the dynamic-programming value at time $i$ and index $a$.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean alphabet
